'''Eyüpspor Kulübü''' (for sponsorship reasons '''{{lang|tr|ikas Eyüpspor}}''') is a Turkish professional football club based in the [[Eyüpsultan]] district of [[Istanbul]]. Founded in 1919, the club is closely associated with the Golden Horn (''Haliç'') and plays in [[Süper Lig]], the top tier of Turkish football.

Eyüpspor's traditional colours are purple and yellow (''eflatun–sarı''). Their long-time home is the Eyüp Stadium; following promotion, the team has staged home fixtures at [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Stadium]] and later at [[Pendik Stadium]] while a new/redeveloped venue in [[Eyüpsultan]] is pursued to meet modern match-day requirements.

Eyüpspor won the [[TFF First League]] in 2023–24 to reach the Süper Lig for the first time, having previously claimed the [[TFF Second League]] (2020–21) and two [[TFF Third League]] titles (1986–87, 2014–15). The club is widely regarded as a neighbourhood side with a strong local following; notable city rivalries include the “Haliç Derby” against [[Kasımpaşa S.K.]], as well as meetings with [[Fatih Karagümrük S.K.|Fatih Karagümrük]] and [[Beykoz 1908 S.K.D.|Beykoz 1908]].

Eyüpspor's recent rise has been overseen by chairman [[Murat Özkaya]] and, following promotion under [[Arda Turan]], the team has been also coached by former international [[Selçuk Şahin (footballer, born 1981)|Selçuk Şahin]].

Murat Özkaya, who is also a [[Galatasaray Sports Club]] congress member, has been arrested for match fixing allegations regarding the [[2025 Turkish football betting scandal]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-07 |title=Futbolda bahis soruşturması: Eyüpspor başkanı ve 3 hakem tutuklandı |url=https://www.bbc.com/turkce/articles/cx2pgzpvg35o |access-date=2026-05-16 |website=BBC News Türkçe |language=tr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-10 |title=Murat Özkaya kimdir? Murat Özkaya hangi takımın başkanı? |url=https://www.haberler.com/haberler/murat-ozkaya-kimdir-murat-ozkaya-hangi-takimin-19239765-haberi/ |access-date=2026-05-16 |website=Haberler |language=tr}}</ref> Since then the club has been owned by Savings Deposit Insurance Fund of Turkey (TMSF).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-16 |title=TMSF, Eyüpspor’un da aralarında bulunduğu Murat Özkaya’ya ait şirketlere kayyum atadı |url=https://www.indyturk.com/node/771419/haber/tmsf-ey%C3%BCpspor%E2%80%99un-da-aralar%C4%B1nda-bulundu%C4%9Fu-murat-%C3%B6zkaya%E2%80%99ya-ait-%C5%9Firketlere-kayyum |access-date=2026-05-16 |website=Independent Türkçe |language=tr}}</ref>"}}
